DEFENSE SECURITY MONITOR: From Ukraine to Jalisco — How Mexican Cartels Weaponized the Skies
May 22, 2026 | 🔴

📰 Niche defense industry outlet frames Mexican cartels as quasi-military actors who sent operatives to Ukraine's International Legion to learn FPV drone warfare. Positions Mexico as a "battlefront" requiring $20M in US counter-drone spending.

Entirely omits: Mexico's own military deployed its First Emergency Response Battalion (C-UAS trained) to protect World Cup venues. The framing implies only US tech can solve the problem — the Mexican state is invisible.

• "Cartel members joined Ukraine's International Legion to gain drone tactics training under one of the most combat-experienced forces in the world"
• "What began as sicarios mounting hand grenades onto commercial quadcopters has evolved into FPV drones with 3D-printed munitions"

GLOBE AND MAIL: Sheinbaum Draws Red Line on Handing Over Politicians Accused of Cartel Ties to U.S.
May 24, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Canada's Globe and Mail frames Sheinbaum as "caught between" party loyalty and Trump demands — while burying the killer stat: Mexico has sent 269 extradition requests to the US since 2018. Zero fulfilled. Not one.

Sheinbaum has already handed over 92 cartel bosses, allowed US surveillance flights, and scrapped "hugs not bullets." The framing of reluctant compliance erases what's actually a one-sided relationship.

• "We have limits to our collaboration — limits that relate precisely to the defence of our sovereignty"
• "We're asking for reciprocity. Why haven't they handed anyone over?"

🇲🇽📊 WARSH TAKES OVER FED AS US INFLATION HITS 3-YEAR HIGH — MEXICO'S DROPS

Kevin Warsh was sworn in as Fed chair on May 22 inheriting US inflation at 3.8% — highest in three years — driven by Washington's own Iran war blowing up energy prices.

Wall Street now bets 54% on a rate HIKE before year's end. Trump wanted cuts. He got his own war instead.

Meanwhile Mexico's inflation dropped to 4.11% in the first half of May. Banxico holding steady at 6.5%. IEPS fuel subsidies keeping gas prices stable while US gas hit $4.54/gallon. The empire's war is eating its own economy.

🚨🇲🇽 SHOTS FIRED AT WHITE HOUSE GATES — TELL US MORE ABOUT HOW MEXICO IS DANGEROUS

A man pulled a gun at 17th and Pennsylvania Avenue and opened fire on Secret Service agents just outside the White House on May 23. Agents returned fire and killed him. A bystander was also struck.

ABC's Selina Wang dropped to the ground live on camera as "dozens of gunshots" rang out at the gates of American democracy.

This is the country that lectures Mexico about security and threatens military intervention to "restore order." A shooting at the literal front door of the presidency — and nobody calls it a failed state.

🇲🇽✊ BIENESTAR OPENS MAY-JUNE PAYMENTS — 3 PROGRAMS, ZERO INTERMEDIARIES

Mexico's Secretaría de Bienestar opened consultations for the May-June bimonthly payment cycle across three core programs: elderly pensions, disability pensions, and children of working mothers.

Every peso goes directly to beneficiaries via the Tarjeta Bienestar — no middlemen, no local bosses skimming off the top. The old clientelist model the PRI spent decades perfecting? Dismantled.

The 4T built a direct-deposit welfare state that reaches tens of millions. Quietly, on schedule, every two months.

🇲🇽🎓 3.5 BILLION PESOS FOR CHIHUAHUA STUDENTS — WHILE MARU DEALS WITH CIA FALLOUT

While Governor Maru Campos dodges senate subpoenas over CIA agents she authorized on Mexican soil, the federal government deployed 3.574 billion pesos in education across her state.

182,269 secondary students on Rita Cetina scholarships. 112,394 on Benito Juárez grants. 2,023 schools upgraded through La Escuela es Nuestra — plus 182 high schools for the first time.

"Students of Chihuahua must not abandon their studies and must have dignified spaces," said Education Secretary Mario Delgado. The federal government builds while the opposition burns.

🇲🇽🛢️ US IRAN WAR CRASHES MEXICO'S FERTILIZER IMPORTS 20%

Mexico's fertilizer imports fell 20.4% in volume from January to April as the Hormuz blockade — triggered by Washington's war on Iran — chokes one-third of the world's fertilizer supply.

Average price per ton jumped 38.9%, from $388 to $538. Urea up 46.7%. Diammonium phosphate up 57.2%.

The US starts wars; the world's farmers pay the bill. Mexico's Fertilizantes para el Bienestar program continues shielding small producers with free direct delivery — the kind of policy the "free market" crowd never builds.

🚨🇲🇽 SHEINBAUM CALLS ALL 32 STATES — NATIONAL REPORT MAY 31

Mexico's president just announced a simultaneous national report across all 32 states on May 31 — marking two years since the 4T's landslide electoral victory.

"Mexico is no one's colony, we are no one's protectorate," Sheinbaum told thousands at the Salomón Quintero Stadium in Teapa, Tabasco. "We must continue strengthening the transformation and always defend national sovereignty."

Not a press conference. Not a decree. A president going to the public plazas of every state at once — direct accountability to the people who elected her.
